تعجرفنا (form IIq)
# تَعَجْرَفْنَا (taʕajrafnā) /ta.ʕad͡ʒ.raf.naː/: first-person plural past active of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تُعُجْرِفْنَا (tuʕujrifnā) /tu.ʕud͡ʒ.rif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
